title: Droppy, the productivity tool for macOS  #github
description:
Droppy, the productivity tool for macOS!  It combines FIVE tools into one slick package: Notch Shelf for hiding files under your webcam, a Floating Basket that pops up anywhere, and a Clipboard Manager that remembers everything you copy. New features? Check! A Media Player right in your notch and Custom Volume & Brightness HUDs that look WAY better than the default.
#github #opensource
